scope: Construction and process-equipment installation of two explicitly selected cast-in-place rectangular reinforced-concrete aeration basins AT-RC-2X30X8X5-FB for two activated-sludge process trains, with 30 m by 8 m plan dimensions, 5 m operating water depth, 9000 Nm3/h design air flow and 240 EPDM-FB-9IN fine-bubble diffusers. Direct civil, aeration-grid, internal utility, labor, mechanism, QA and logistics inputs are project-owned.
sourceAuthority: Approved wastewater process and structural designer, diffuser-grid supplier, equipment manufacturers, commissioning laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: complete treatment plant, inlet works, MBR, UV, sludge dewatering or external networks
civil, aeration-grid, labor, mechanism or logistics quantities derived from basin dimensions, train count or air flow
automatic blowers, mixers, recycle pumps, draining/bypass or odor control
universal retained spare or supplier-package quantity
